page.overview:
Who is Zeva Bliss?

Zeva Bliss was a human female criminal who led the gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi Zeva was also the mother of Zorii Bliss. Zorii joined the gang at a young age, but refused to have special treatment as the daughter of the gang's leader.

Zeva was the daughter of smuggler pilot Zarah Bliss and an unknown father. She was raised on Kijimi, where the Ashiga Clan dominated the criminal underworld. Zarah had organized independent Spice Smugglers in the system, turning them into a de facto trade union. By 4 ABY, Zarah had died and Zeva had inherited the organization. She quickly went to work transforming it from a loose coalition to a fully unified Syndicate.

Following the deaths of Darth Vader and Darth Sidious at the Battle of Endor, the Empire was splintered, but Grand Moff Ubrik Adelhard still retained control of the Anoat sector. Brilliant but insane, Adelhard was convinced that Vader had chosen him to carry the torch for the Empire if anything happened to Imperial High Command. Adelhard knew that he would need allies in the underworld, and he also knew that the Spice Runners were eager to step out of the shadow of the Ashiga Clan, so he approached Zeva, proposing that she offer mercenary support to his forces. Zeva agreed, and subsequently approached Bib Fortuna, suggesting that the Hutt Clan similarly ally with Adelhard. Fortuna refused, laughingly suggesting that Zeva had gone mad.

When Adelhard suffered his first defeat at the hands of Luke Skywalker, Lando Calrissian, and the aforementioned Taskforce, he demanded vengeance. Zeva accommodated him by placing a bounty on the head of General Skywalker, a move that her advisor, Tomasso, considered to be brazen even for her. Zeva had two bounty hunters, the Trandoshan Kranor and the Arcona Cyborg Lan-Drus, that she kept on retainer for assassinations. She directed both of them to eliminate targets she knew that Adelhard would want dead. Kranor assassinated Senator Mirim Kess while Lan-Drus assassinated New Republic Intelligence director Calder Behrens. Kranor also attempted to assassinate Skywalker, attacking him on Chandrila, but timely intervention by Leia Skywalker Organa Solo and her security detail forced him to retreat. Zeva eventually began to tire of Adelhard's instability, so using Kranor as her proxy, she supported Reyna Oskure and Kith Alaytia in their mutiny against the defiant Imperial.
